product: A shared job board so independent design studios can track briefs, files, and approvals in one place.
target_customer: Independent design studios with 2 to 10 people

known_research.detail: 40 per workspace per month, from the business plan.
Two studio interviews. One described a costly approval failure; one did not.

market_definition: The buying unit is a U.S. design studio that runs client work for outside clients. In: graphic, branding, and packaging studios. Out: in-house design teams, freelancers working alone, and large agencies with their own project tooling.
industry: Graphic design services (NAICS 541430), within specialized design services (NAICS 5414).

segments.traits: 2 to 10 people. The owner still sends work for approval.
segments.buyers: Assumption: 60% of graphic design establishments. A live run should web-search County Business Patterns size bands for NAICS 541430 and open the table page.

segments.traits: One person. BLS reports 20% of graphic designers are self-employed.
segments.buyers: Out of scope for the first product. Not counted.

segments.traits: More than 10 people, often with project managers and existing tools.
segments.buyers: Out of scope for the first product. Not counted.

sizing_inputs.label: assumption
sizing_inputs.basis: Example only: no establishment table was opened. Web-search graphic design establishments NAICS 541430 United States and cite the official table page.

sizing_inputs.label: assumption
sizing_inputs.basis: Web-search CBP employee size bands for NAICS 541430 and open the HTML table, not the Data API.

sizing_inputs.label: given
sizing_inputs.basis: Three-year objective in the business plan, through founder outreach.

market.basis: Assumption: establishment count not opened. Every U.S. graphic design studio at the planned price.
Assumption: size-band share not opened. Studios with 2 to 10 people only.
Founder outreach capacity in three years, from the business plan. Not a percent of TAM.

sensitivity.driver: Share with 2 to 10 people, from 40% to 75%.
Studios won in three years, from 10 to 50.

trends.trend: Graphic designer employment is projected to shrink slightly.
trends.evidence: BLS projects a 2% decline from 2025 to 2035, from 253,100 jobs in 2025.

trends.trend: Design work stays spread across many small employers.
trends.evidence: BLS reports 20% of graphic designers are self-employed and 9% work in specialized design services.

demand_signals.finding: Many general project tools are listed. No listing opened was built only for studio approvals.
Buyers compare general work tools. No review opened asked for a studio-only approval board.
Designers discuss client feedback and file versions. No opened thread asked to pay for a tool.

alternatives.name: Email and spreadsheets
alternatives.note: Free and already in use. The habit to replace.

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.note: General work management. Studios must build the approval path.

alternatives.name: Basecamp
alternatives.note: Client projects and files in one place, not a design-approval path.

alternatives.name: Frame.io
alternatives.note: Review and approval, built for video rather than a studio job board.

attractiveness.evidence: SAM is about 3,168,000 a year at the planned price, on assumed counts.
BLS projects a 2% decline in graphic designer jobs from 2025 to 2035.
Studios gather in AIGA chapters and agency directories. The founder reaches studios directly.
General tools are strong, but none opened ships the studio approval path.

verdict_reason: Size, Reachability, and Competition are medium, but Growth is low and the establishment count and size share are assumptions. The market is large enough for a founder-led business, but a web search must open official table pages before it is called attractive.

evidence_gaps.how_to_close: Web-search County Business Patterns graphic design services establishments, open the Census Bureau table page, and record the count.

evidence_gaps.gap: Share of studios with 2 to 10 people
evidence_gaps.how_to_close: Web-search CBP employment size bands for NAICS 541430 and open the same release as an HTML table.
Ask interviewed studios for a pre-order or a paid pilot.

assumptions.text: 11,000 graphic design establishments, to be replaced by a count from an official table page found by web search.
60% of establishments have 2 to 10 people, to be replaced by a size-band table from the same search.
Ranges: 8,000 to 14,000 establishments, a 40% to 75% size share, and 10 to 50 studios won in three years.
